units.summary: Adds a test passing unsorted, duplicated refs to CompactSelectedSeries and checks compaction succeeds, all series are evicted and one block is written. New test only, no production effect.
units.headline: New test for unsorted and duplicate refs in CompactSelectedSeries
units.reason: New test-only code that cannot affect production behavior.

units.summary: Exported type StaleHead is renamed to SelectedSeriesHead and its field renamed and retyped to the generalized seriesRefs. External callers of StaleHead (for example downstream projects) would break at compile time.
units.headline: StaleHead type renamed to SelectedSeriesHead
units.reason: Exported type rename changes the public API of the tsdb package.
focus: downstream users of the exported StaleHead type
all remaining references to StaleHead and staleSeriesRefs updated

units.summary: Constructor renamed from NewStaleHead and takes the generalized seriesRefs. Behavior is otherwise identical.
units.headline: NewStaleHead renamed to NewSelectedSeriesHead
units.reason: Mechanical rename of a constructor with the same body, used by both stale and selected compaction callers.

units.summary: Index now delegates to selectedSeriesIndex instead of staleIndex, using the generalized refs. Stale compaction runs through this path too.
units.headline: Index delegates to selectedSeriesIndex instead of staleIndex
units.reason: Delegation to the renamed index builder; the behavior lives in the separate head_read.go unit.

units.summary: NumSeries now returns the length of the selected refs list rather than the head's global stale series count. It feeds Meta().Stats.NumSeries used by the compactor.
units.headline: NumSeries now counts selected refs instead of head stale series
units.reason: Changes the value reported to the compactor and block meta, including for stale head compaction.
focus: compactor use of Meta().Stats.NumSeries for stale compaction
refs list may include series filtered or evicted later

units.summary: The synthetic ULID for the head view is renamed and changed to a new constant string. It is only used as the placeholder meta ULID of the in-memory view.
units.headline: Synthetic head view ULID renamed and value changed
units.reason: Placeholder identifier for an in-memory view; not persisted as a real block ID.

units.summary: Meta uses the renamed receiver and ULID constant. Otherwise unchanged.
units.headline: Meta uses renamed receiver and ULID
units.reason: Mechanical rename; NumSeries behavior change is covered in its own unit.

units.summary: String output text changes from stale head to selected-series head and the doc comment typo is fixed. Affects only log and error text.
units.headline: String output now says selected-series head
units.reason: Only log and error message text changes.
